pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.description: How FlutterReleases handles website usage data, analytics, and browser preferences.

sections.title: About this website and contact
paragraphs: FlutterReleases is an independent Flutter release reference. For privacy questions or requests, email contact@flutterreleases.com.

sections.title: Website requests and analytics
paragraphs: Cloudflare hosts and delivers this website. Website requests can include IP addresses, requested URLs, browser and device information, and request headers. Cloudflare processes traffic information to deliver and secure the service.

We use Google Analytics 4 to understand visits, traffic sources, navigation, and use of release searches, downloads, and the compatibility checker. Google Analytics can use cookies and receive information such as page URLs, device and browser details, and interactions. URLs may include query parameters; avoid entering personal or sensitive information into website searches or URLs.

We also use self-hosted Minilytics at minilytics.flutterreleases.workers.dev to measure visits, referral sources, page navigation, SDK download clicks, compatibility-tool entry, and support-link clicks. Its tracking script uses first-party cookies named ml_vid and ml_sid to associate visits with a visitor and session. These identifiers and usage events are sent to our Minilytics service. We do not send account identities or payment metadata from this website because it has no account or checkout flow.
We use these measurements to understand which resources are useful and improve the website. Analytics is not a recording of everything you do and does not tell us why you leave.

links.label: How Google uses information from partner sites

sections.title: Browser preferences
paragraphs: The website initially follows your system color scheme. If you toggle the theme, your browser stores a light or dark preference in localStorage under the theme key. You can remove it by clearing this site's browser storage.
Code-copy buttons write the selected code to your clipboard only when you click them.

sections.title: Information you send us
paragraphs: If you email us, we receive the address, message, and any information you choose to send. We use it to respond and handle your request. Do not send sensitive information that is unnecessary for your question. The website does not offer user accounts or collect payment details itself.

sections.title: Providers, external links, and retention
paragraphs: Google and Cloudflare process information according to their services and policies, which may involve processing outside your country. External services, including GitHub, X, official SDK download hosts, and the support platform, operate under their own privacy policies.

Analytics retention depends on the configured Google Analytics and self-hosted Minilytics settings; hosting and security data retention depends on provider settings and policies. Contact correspondence is retained as needed to handle requests and applicable obligations. Contact us for information about current settings or a deletion request.

sections.title: Your choices and requests
paragraphs: You can manage cookies and site storage in your browser, block analytics requests, or use Google's Analytics opt-out browser add-on where supported. These choices do not prevent the hosting provider from processing requests needed to deliver and secure the website.

Depending on the law applicable to you, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or restrict processing of personal information, object to processing, or complain to a supervisory authority. Email us to ask about your information or exercise applicable rights. We may need proportionate information to verify a request.
This notice describes data handling; it is not consent to analytics. Consent requirements depend on applicable law.

sections.title: Policy updates
paragraphs: We may update this notice when the website or data practices change. The date above identifies the latest content revision.

sections.title: About the service
paragraphs: FlutterReleases is a free, independent reference. It provides Flutter release information, bundled Dart SDK mappings, links, articles, and machine-readable resources. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google or the Flutter team. For questions, email contact@flutterreleases.com.

sections.title: Verify information before relying on it
paragraphs: Release information is collected from upstream sources and updated automatically. Updates can be delayed, sources can change, and errors can occur. Check the linked official sources before making production, migration, or security decisions.

The compatibility checker describes which Dart SDK is bundled with a Flutter release. It does not establish that arbitrary Dart SDK versions can be substituted into a Flutter installation. Articles are technical references, not a guarantee that a procedure fits your project.

sections.title: Reasonable use
paragraphs: You may browse and use the public dataset and machine-readable resources, including through automated tools. Respect published content-use preferences, applicable licenses, and any service limits. Do not disrupt the service, circumvent security controls, attempt unauthorized access, or use it unlawfully.

sections.title: Content and licenses
paragraphs: The repository's MIT license governs code covered by that license; these terms do not withdraw those permissions. Flutter, Dart, SDK binaries, logos, and linked upstream material remain subject to their respective owners' rights and licenses. Do not imply an endorsement when reusing information.

sections.title: External services
paragraphs: SDK downloads are hosted by upstream providers, not FlutterReleases. Linked services and optional support transactions are governed by those providers' terms and policies. We do not process payments on this website or control external service availability.

sections.title: Availability and responsibility
paragraphs: The service is provided as available, without a promise of uninterrupted access, completeness, or fitness for a particular purpose. To the extent permitted by applicable law, the operator is not responsible for losses arising from reliance on incorrect information or unavailable services. Nothing here excludes rights or responsibilities that cannot legally be excluded.

sections.title: Changes and contact
paragraphs: Features and these terms may change as the website develops. The date above identifies the latest revision. For questions, contact contact@flutterreleases.com. See the Privacy Policy for information about analytics and data handling.
